title: A unified approach to cross-intersection problems with applications to Hilton--Milner type theorems and stability
summary: We develop a new approach to cross-intersection problems in extremal set theory. The method builds on the iterative procedure introduced by Kupavskii and Zakharov (2024) and the $t$-cover method. It provides a flexible framework for deriving extremal and stability results for cross $t$-intersecting families. Our approach applies to a variety of combinatorial objects. As an application, we prove a product version of the seminal Erdős--Ko--Rado theorem for sufficiently spread set systems.
